answers.core: This would make setting up navigation regions a much easier process since you can overlap meshes across different regions.
answers.workaround: This could likely be done in a hacky way with existing code in a plugin that just does a PhysicsQuery in a box area, gets all colliders in that area, adds them to a temp group, instances a NavigationMesh node, sets it to bake nodes in that group, bakes, then removes the colliders from that group.

title: Make so NavigationMeshes can be set to only bake an area in a bounding box
